notes: Made-up week #3027. The starting schedule is built the way a careful scheduler works: trip by trip, the jet that can make it with the least extra empty flying, then the first legal crew, keeping pilots on their jet when possible. Vorian's edge is planning all the trips at once.
This week the scheduler slipped: at least once it kept a crew on their jet for the next trip without re-checking their rest or flight time, the kind of miss a busy desk makes. Vorian catches it.
Random weeks are kept for this page when Vorian suggests 2 to 4 changes. On 60 random weeks it suggested no change on 18: the careful schedule was already its best.
Aircraft speeds are placeholders, so flight times and empty miles are rough.
